name: [11 HOURS] Grimoires Era
desc:
🔥 GRIMOIRES REBORN | NEW CODE AT 130K Likes! 🎁

Black Clover inspired game.

⚔️ Grimoires Reborn marks the epic return of the magical universe you’ve been waiting for. Reworked with new systems, enhanced visuals, and even more intense combat. Fully compatible with Mobile, PC, Console, and other platforms.

🌟 Choose your path. Become the most legendary magic user, nullify magic with brute force, or master the blade against powerful bosses. Create the strongest guild, discover hidden secrets, and evolve using rare grimoires, unique skills, and powerful equipment.

👑 Premium players receive extra rewards in the AFK World. Progress even while offline.

✨ Make sure to favorite the game to stay updated on new codes, special events, and future updates.

🎮 Controls:
Shift - Sprint
CTRL - Shift Lock
Q - Dash
F - Block
